races.paceDynamic: Birkenhead will break first but this isn't a confirmed tearaway pace - the prominent runners Miss Rainbow, Lucius Aurelius and Fortunate Star can all sit close without being burned off. With six hold-up horses including improving Tuscan Point and consistent Tommy McJohn, there's significant closing power waiting behind what should be a sensible early tempo. The lack of genuine speed means the pace will be measured rather than ferocious, setting up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to unleash late kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit what will likely be a sprint finish after steady early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady with Birkenhead leading without pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows closers like Tuscan Point, Tommy McJohn and Nacho Nacho Nacho to position perfectly before unleashing finishing kicks that the pace-setters cannot match. The hold-up horses' superior turn of foot decides this in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow or Fortunate Star can sit close to Birkenhead then quicken before the hold-up horses get organized
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners times their move perfectly to get first run on the field while the hold-up horses are still winding up. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they steal a march entering the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Birkenhead Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very slow and Birkenhead gets an uncontested lead with too much left in the tank
scenarios.body: The veteran exploits soft fractions to dictate throughout and has enough energy reserves to resist the inevitable late challenge. His experience in this scenario keeps the closers at bay just long enough.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and the field arrives in one group at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse can win depending on position and momentum at the crucial moment. Form and ratings become secondary to who gets the clearest run and best acceleration.

watchPoints.text: Birkenhead could get an uncontested lead if the prominent horses settle too far back early
Tuscan Point's stamina for five furlongs is unproven after recent six-furlong success
Miss Rainbow and Fortunate Star both need to avoid getting trapped behind horses in the straight
Several hold-up horses including Tommy McJohn and Nacho Nacho Nacho return from lengthy breaks
The inside draw could be crucial for Birkenhead to control the tempo from the front

races.paceDynamic: Victor Cee stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the off. With no obvious pace pressure, he can control the tempo and potentially steal a march on his rivals. The prominent runners Soca Star, Naana's Shadow, Rotokura Belle and Come On Over will track him in the early positions, while hold-up horses Paroda Diva and Moretons rely on finding gaps late. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can position close to Victor Cee early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Victor Cee Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Victor Cee gets away with soft fractions and dictates the pace uncontested
scenarios.body: He can kick clear in the straight with his rivals arriving too late to catch him. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a telling late burst.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get closer to Victor Cee and apply more pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The increased gallop will set up a fierce finish where the best-handicapped prominent racer can strike. Soca Star and Rotokura Belle are best positioned to benefit from this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field bunches up approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks. Paroda Diva and Moretons will have their optimal conditions to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the less fancied horses gets the perfect trip and benefits from the pace dynamics
scenarios.body: Come On Over or Naana's Shadow could outrun their odds if positioned ideally behind the pace. Their class on paper suggests they have more to offer than recent form indicates.

watchPoints.text: Victor Cee's fitness after 106 days off could see him fold late despite controlling the early pace
Paroda Diva and Moretons may struggle to get competitive if the pace is as steady as expected
Rotokura Belle's recent 5f win at this level makes her the form pick if tracking Victor Cee successfully
Come On Over's long absence and step back to 5f creates uncertainty about his current wellbeing
The draw could be crucial with several prominent runners needing to get handy early from wide berths

This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration after the front-runners have set solid fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flourishes
scenarios.trigger: If Lord and Mythical Valentine establish genuine early pace
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for King Of Roses to produce his finishing kick, while any late closer benefits from the honest tempo. Tide Lines could also capitalize if showing the ability to quicken despite his unknown running style.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Cranachan settles better in the early stages

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If both Lord and Mythical Valentine go too fast early
scenarios.body: Their aggressive styles could lead to mutual destruction over this demanding trip, allowing any horse with tactical pace to pick up the pieces. Cranachan's prominent style positions him perfectly for this scenario.

This scenario strongly favours hold-up horses like Enduring Story and Cotai Starlight who can capitalise on a slowly-run race with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A

The four hold-up horses (Aberama Gold, Dorney Lake, Vingegaard) will be tracking from midfield in what becomes a proper test. With only one confirmed front-runner and two prominent runners, this sets up as a tactical affair that won't become truly searching until the final 2f. This pace profile strongly favours the prominent runners and those with tactical speed to position close up early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Yorkshire Glory or No Return can settle close to Rosenpur without being drawn into early pace pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical sprint where the prominent pair can use their positions to strike approaching the final furlong while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. Yorkshire Glory's recent AW form and tactical speed make him the key beneficiary of this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur sets genuine fractions and the prominent runners commit too early to match the pace
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes testing enough to set up a strong finish for the patient hold-up horses who can use their finishing kicks. Aberama Gold and Dorney Lake benefit most from this scenario with their proven ability to close strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur gets an easy lead with the prominent runners content to sit and the hold-up horses too far back
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian enough for Rosenpur to control throughout and kick clear in the straight before the closers can respond. His stamina and front-running style suit this tactical scenario despite his 170-day absence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If all runners sit off Rosenpur creating a crawling pace that becomes a 2f dash
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint finish where horses with the best turn of foot regardless of position can win. This chaotic finish could suit any horse with tactical speed but makes the result highly unpredictable.
